s00593.summary: Lupe spots Mrs. Baptiste and the friends bury the stolen trophy in nachos
The four freeze as an adult passes, then exhale and tease Archie
The shape turns back and Archie frantically stuffs the trophy into his hood
With the danger gone, the friends dissolve into helpless laughter

s01231.summary: Eveline enters the shuttered parlour and takes in the sheets and stopped clock
Eveline uncovers a phonograph cylinder addressed to her and winds it up
Her younger self vows never to leave the house; Eveline whispers liar
Eveline silences the recording and sits in the dusty light without weeping
She restarts the stopped clock, letting time move again

s01998.summary: Defense and prosecution talk over each other arguing Seraphina's sentence
The judge quiets counsel and gently presses Seraphina to speak
Seraphina admits she took the money while her mother was ill
Moved, Odalys withdraws the State's recommendation for the maximum
The judge takes the matter under advisement and adjourns as Seraphina lingers

s00352.summary: Henry pushes the family to accept the offer while Danny resists
Rose challenges Henry to repeat to her face that Dad is dead
Screwdrivers spill everywhere and the brothers snap while Danny gathers them
Rose reveals Dad's cigar box of forty years of forgiven customer debts
Henry sits among the screwdrivers as Fritz admits writing half the cards
Danny refuses to sell and Henry commits the family to running the store

s01517.summary: Gwendolen grills Abebe about the moldy registers before the inspector's visit
Fatima reports only eleven pupils remain; the rest left for the city
A small boy knocks asking for school and Gwendolen welcomes the twelfth

s01832.summary: Six strangers sit to a silent, uneasy meal at Ma Tulliver's way station
Orville attempts small talk and Sabina learns she missed the stage
Sabina and Oscar needle the silent stranger until Oscar shoves his bowl away
Ma Tulliver circles behind Jude's chair as the room braces
Jude reaches into his duster and produces a letter from his father

s01286.summary: Priyanka scolds the late birthday clown and drags out his real name, Gerald
Dolores warns Gerald that the staring goat hates clowns
The goat charges and Gerald flees across the yard with everyone chasing
Gerald lands in the pen, the goat eats his wig, Teddy cheers

s02254.summary: Felix tells hesitant Noor she does not have to dive the platform
Noor falters on the ladder as Felix invokes his father's dive
Felix kneels at the pool edge and promises to be right there
Noor climbs to the top and stands trembling at the edge
Noor makes Felix cover his eyes, laughs, and finally steps off

s00554.summary: Odile chisels the old chute wall while Marcellus times the delivery truck
The brick falls and Tobias learns the tunnel leads to a bank vault
Odile hushes Tobias and wins his trust to hold the lantern
Odile crawls into the dark while Marcellus explains she listens to the lock
The vault clicks open; Tobias laughs and Marcellus says they bake

s00660.summary: Mags opens her mine-bottom summit to a cold, complaining team
The silent stranger speaks up and cryptically says he is observing everything
Tybalt reveals the company was bought last Thursday; nobody read the email
The stranger reveals himself as Raymond from Acquisitions and skewers Mags's chart
Mags gives up and sits as colleagues quietly console each other
Raymond offers sandwiches and only Tybalt raises his hand

s00853.summary: Elspeth accuses Abernathy of breaking her window with a bowling ball
Faircloth laments the makeshift court and his gavel rolls away

s00237.summary: Maeve sends a mayday from the flooding wheelhouse as Ruth fights the wheel
Ruth seizes the mic and announces they will abandon ship
The pump dies and Maeve dives into the flooded corner for the flare
They burst topside, fire the flare, and a searchlight finds them

s02203.summary: Elspeth convenes the cell, warning someone is about to leak
Cecilia asks why they meet in an open-roofed observatory
Elspeth checks everyone's devices; Cecilia admits she left hers home
Elspeth explains they will feed false information to flush out the leak
Elspeth assigns three false stories, with a special one for Hamza
Elspeth forbids leaving before dawn and sends Cecilia off with Oksana
Hamza asks if Oksana suspects; Elspeth trusts her paranoia

s00171.summary: Nacho arrives soaked after years and sets a ring before silent Bernadette
Bernadette chides Nacho for his eleven-year absence and their father's death
Nacho says Dad asked for him and accuses Bernie of keeping him out
Bernadette sweeps the shirts away, Nacho kicks the duffel, the ring vanishes

s00184_0.summary: Ruth closes her argument about the excluded recording to a skeptical Justice
A bailiff's note leads the Justice to announce the conviction will be vacated
A phone call confirms the real priest appeared and Ruth exhales
Ruth thanks the Justice, trades dry remarks, and walks out unsteadily

s01191.summary: Teodora and Desmond enter the eerie carousel workshop bantering about its character
Teodora greets Old Harlan, who keeps painting as Desmond stumbles
Harlan turns, revealing a carved hinged face, as the horses begin to turn

s01986.summary: Leonie shows the 1982 bottles carry 2014 corks and declares fraud
Nate turns on Maximilian, who insists he sold excellent wine
Leonie implicates Dorothea's signature; blame bounces until Dorothea snaps
A creak upstairs prompts Leonie to search the stairs with her flashlight
Leonie demands everyone's phones as noises sound from above
Her flashlight dies and heavy footsteps descend in the dark

s02260.summary: Kalinda stretches on the frosty track and plays her day 107 log
Jogging, she hears older logs of struggle and her mother's teasing
Her day-one memo urges her to run freely; she strides into dawn

s01450.summary: Orsolya tends the glass orchard and laments that no apple falls
A deep chime from the roots makes Orsolya kneel and listen
Kaedmon appears bearing iron and Orsolya warns him of the orchard
Kaedmon reveals the forbidden black seed and the orchard falls silent
Kaedmon plants the seed; Orsolya fights him as the orchard bursts into flame

s00035.summary: Roz and Dennis frantically try to force the frozen freezer door
The tuxedoed stranger Lazarus claims he has been trapped for days
Roz notices Lazarus's breath doesn't fog; he apologetically hints at death
Roz and Dennis smash the door open; Lazarus waves farewell inside

s02041.summary: Barnaby teases his nervous new assistant Penelope during evening rounds
Barnaby introduces the shy python Gladys and her rules
Penelope stares at Gladys, who slowly tilts her head back
Barnaby feeds Gladys and praises Penelope's steady nerve
Barnaby reveals Gladys is a decoy and the real snake is loose
A thump in the vent freezes both as something coils above

s02089.summary: Archie charges that Dorothea's bees used his clover without paying
Truman enjoys the show and a goat interrupts proceedings
The judge settles the case with a jar of honey

s02108.summary: Doctors fight to resuscitate a crashing patient on the concourse
Jude arrives with epi, they push it and shock the patient
A weak heartbeat returns and Anselm routes the patient to intensive care
Exhausted doctors argue over resting until Beatriz makes both sit

s00719.summary: The crew battles a failing core as Ximena and Tuck dispute the countdown
Ravi bursts in with shield failure news and is ordered to a console
Ximena and Tuck push the lever together and the core shudders
Halloran promises a round as the core settles and all grin

s00062.summary: Coach Horty prepares nervous rookie Josefina for her first jam
Bruiser takes Josefina under her wing and the team walks out to roars
